Application Data.NAME: TeleCom Solutions Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: TeleCom Solutions Inc. provides comprehensive answering and telemarketing services, specializing in inbound and outbound call handling for various industries. Our operations adhere strictly to regulatory compliance, including the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), and CAN-SPAM Act. We maintain robust IT security protocols, including firewalls and encrypted data storage, and conduct thorough employee background checks to ensure a trustworthy workforce. Our hybrid workforce model combines in-office and remote agents, supported by strong cybersecurity measures such as VPNs and multi-factor authentication, ensuring the protection of sensitive information while delivering exceptional client service. Regular employee training on compliance and quality assurance measures further strengthens our commitment to operational integrity and customer satisfaction.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: TeleCom Solutions Inc. operates a small remote customer support service under the name "RemoteAssist Services," focusing on providing technical assistance and answering services for various IT clients.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Date of Loss: 03/15/2023; Cause: Data breach due to inadequate cybersecurity measures; Amount: $15,000.00; Status: Closed.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Preferred:
– Businesses demonstrating rigorous compliance with the Telephone Consumer Protec-
tion Act (TCPA), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), and CAN-SPAM Act, including
documented policies and regular employee training on regulatory requirements.
– On-site call centers equipped with robust IT security infrastructure such as firewalls,
intrusion detection systems, encrypted data storage, and limited remote access protocols
to reduce cybersecurity risks.
– Operations characterized by low employee turnover, comprehensive employee background
checks, and clear monitoring and quality assurance protocols to mitigate risks related to
employee misconduct or errors.

– Businesses operating with a hybrid workforce model (combining in-office and remote
